evidence.quote: The 0-based index of the page number being requested.
Maximum calls per client: 25 requests per a minute
The Retry-After header is included in the 429 response
Only “active” users are returned by Get User Information and Get Users in Organization

assumptions: The users list puts the page number in the URL path (/users/{orgId}/{page}), not in a query parameter. The manifest format cannot express this cleanly, so the path is fixed to page 0 and the page_number setting with a 'page' parameter is a placeholder. As written, the connector may read only the first page (up to 2000 users). The runtime needs path-based paging support, or this must be reviewed by hand.

The API reports the last page with lastPage: true. The format has no way to say 'stop when true', so hasMorePath is left empty. The docs say an out-of-range page returns the last page again, so a runtime that does not stop on lastPage could loop.

Adobe requires an x-api-key header (the Client ID) on every call in addition to the OAuth token. Credential headers cannot be set outside the auth method, so it is not in extraHeaders. The Client ID is kept as the 'apiKey' connection field, but the manifest cannot send it as a header. The runtime must send it alongside the OAuth token, or this needs manual handling; otherwise calls will fail with 403 (missing API key).

The source says only users with status 'active' are returned by the organization listing. Suspended or removed people are therefore probably missing, even though they may still hold licences. The status mappings for disabled, locked and removed come from the documented values but may never appear.
The 'id' field is documented as the unique identifier, but the examples show no id. I fall back to email when it is missing.
The page size is not set. The docs say the page size is variable, currently at most 2000, and is reported in the X-Page-Size response header.
The listing excludes Technical Accounts (service accounts) according to the X-Total-Count note, so those will not appear.
No role field exists on the user record. Admin roles are only shown through group names such as _org_admin, so role is left empty.

Usage is marked unavailable because the provided documentation shows no last-login field, audit log or usage report. The source text was cut off, so a later section may contain something I could not see.
The IMS token URL is the North America host (ims-na1). Other regions were not documented.
Only the rate limit of 25 requests per minute for the user listing is stated. No rate-limit headers are documented, only a Retry-After header on 429 responses.
The user type values adobeID, enterpriseID and federatedID are all mapped to member. This is my judgement, because the docs do not say which are guests.
